reply: K70CTL R id=<16hex> boot=<16hex> cmd=<name> status=<status> <fields>
dispatch: foreground or worker after USB poll returns; never console producer or RX event
boot_zero: read-only queries only; replay/reset require exact nonzero boot
reset_guard: 10-second token, single-use even for wrong-token confirmation; no automatic PMIC fallback
reset_ack: atomic append exact interval must remain retained and be covered by current committed cursor; TxBytes not used; USB HALTED required before reset

psci.input_provenance: host must bind ADT method/compatible to independently verified complete live FDT
psci.normal_PE_restart_unavailable_early: fixed XNU normal path needs PMRootDomain; pinned platform has no haltRestart override or PE_halt_restart registration

scope: diagnostics and authorized automated reset only; no storage/MMIO/memory-write/root/OS, clock, SMMU or crypto changes
